jei.dirtrobes.info.gauntlet: Worn in the Gauntlet slot (Curios). Left-click it with the Prizmod to insert it, right-click with an empty hand to remove it. Keys: B deploy / retract the blade (it appears when your hand is empty and uses the weapon's stats), Z extract a fossil (extraction module), P team screen. Upgrades at the smithing table: module + gauntlet + a mineral, or Blade Module + gauntlet + a sword (the old weapon is given back).
jei.dirtrobes.info.module: Smithing table: module + gauntlet + a mineral. The Blade Module also accepts a sword instead of the mineral: the sword becomes the gauntlet's weapon and keeps its enchantments.
jei.dirtrobes.info.prizmod: Right-click: your team (6 Spectrobes, 2 out). Sneak + right-click your Spectrobe: sit / follow. Sneak + right-click the air: call your Spectrobes back. Fits into the gauntlet.
jei.dirtrobes.info.combat_item: Right-click to use it on one of your Spectrobes. One item per fight: %ss shared cooldown.
jei.dirtrobes.info.fossil: Only obtained by extracting a fossil stone with the gauntlet (extraction module, Z key). Put it in an incubator and dig it out of its rock to awaken it.
jei.dirtrobes.info.incubator: Awakening a fossil: 2 minutes. Electricity (FE, e.g. Create: New Age) speeds it up: +2 speed for %s FE/tick. With Create, right-click with a cogwheel to fit it into the incubator: meshed with another cogwheel, it adds +1 speed per %s RPM. Bonuses stack.
message.dirtrobes.core_no_weapon: Only some evolved Spectrobes can power a weapon.
jei.dirtrobes.info.spectrobe_core: Use the empty core on your evolved Spectrobe (it is not consumed) to charge it. At the smithing table: module (blade, fist or cannon) + gauntlet + charged core = that Spectrobe's weapon, as in Spectrobes Origins. The previous weapon gives its core back.
gui.dirtrobes.pc.to_cobblemon.tooltip: Sends the selected Spectrobe to your Cobblemon party (or Cobblemon PC if the party is full). It keeps its level and species.
gui.dirtrobes.pc.from_cobblemon.tooltip: Brings back every Spectrobe from your Cobblemon party, with the level and evolution they reached.

message.dirtrobes.cobblemon.none_back: No Spectrobe could come back (battle in progress or storage full).
